name: Open Code Review
tagline: Alibaba's hybrid AI code review — deterministic rules plus LLM
description: Open Code Review is Alibaba's open-source AI code-review engine that combines deterministic, rule-based checks with LLM-driven analysis. It pairs fast, reliable static checks with model-based insights so teams get both precision and judgment in a single review pass. It ships as a Claude Code plugin and integrates directly into existing review workflows. Built in Go, it is designed to be self-hosted and fits into CI pipelines without external dependencies.
highlights: Hybrid pipeline: deterministic rules plus LLM-based review
Ships as a Claude Code plugin for drop-in integration
Self-hosted and CI-friendly with no external dependencies
curatorNote: Most AI review tools are all-LLM or all-rules; Alibaba's hybrid approach pairs deterministic checks with model judgment, and shipping it as a Claude Code plugin makes it immediately usable.
